facts: Warranty deed conveying a residential parcel from Margaret Doyle to her son Kevin Doyle for $1, described as a gift. Kevin moves into the house as his own home. No commercial use. PTA filed 15 days after transfer. The parcel is classified as residential real property under MCL 211.34c. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: Clean 27a(7)(u) parent-to-child residential transfer with no change in use. Baseline no-uncap. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
